description: Checks up to 10 UK EORI numbers (GB or XI followed by 12 or 15 digits) with HMRC's public check: valid or not, with the processing date. HMRC does not publish the trader's name in this check, so it is null. An HMRC outage is a 503, not charged, never 'invalid'. EU EORI numbers are refused with a 400 in this version. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

eori.description: One UK EORI number, or up to 10 separated by commas, e.g. GB123456789000
